technique_name: Explain the relationship between consumer behavior and marketing
description: Consumer behavior is the study of how and why individuals purchase, use, and dispose of products and services. It is a critical factor in marketing, as marketers use consumer behavior to understand consumer needs, preferences, and motivation. By understanding consumer behavior, marketers can more effectively design marketing strategies and create campaigns that will resonate with their target customers.
